newsitem.title: USA: Dow industrials flat after Fed holds rates steady.
newsitem.headline: Dow industrials flat after Fed holds rates steady.

text.p: The Dow industrials were little changed late Wednesday afternoon after the Federal Reserve's policy-making committee announced its decision to leave U.S. interest rates unchanged.

Analysts said stocks were unlikely to get much of a lift from the outcome of the Fed meeting, as it was widely anticipated. Investors were now focusing on Thursday's report on June employment, they said.
The Dow was off about six points at 7717. The Nasdaq composite was up about nine to 1446.
